issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify Milkable.messageOnMilk() should return a String (e.g., "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"), but the solution defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() with return type boolean and implementations (Seal, Goat) print the message and return true. This return-type mismatch (String vs boolean) will confuse students and cause integration/compilation mismatches with example usage in Main which prints messageOnMilk()'s result.
issues.suggestedFix: Make Milkable.messageOnMilk() return String to match the UML and textual specification. Update the Milkable interface signature to 'String messageOnMilk();' and modify Seal and Goat to return the string "[Animal Type] [name] is milked" (without printing inside the method). Also update any callers (e.g., Main) if necessary to reflect the returned String.
